wifi-p2p

wifi-p2p — Wi-Fi P2P Settings

Properties

Table 55. 

Key Name Value Type Default Value Value Description 
autonomous
 
boolean
 
FALSE
 Create a non-persistent autonomous group owner without a peer. The group remains active when no clients are present, until the connection is deactivated. Uses the wpa_supplicant backend. Downstream 1.58.1 extension. 
client
 
boolean
 
FALSE
 Join an existing group with SSID and PSK using a separate P2P client interface. Excludes autonomous GO, peer and WPS. Downstream extension. 
frequency
 
uint32
 
0
 Requested autonomous GO frequency in MHz. Zero follows the current station frequency when connected, otherwise lets supplicant choose. An explicit frequency conflicting with an active station is rejected. Also accepts an existing group frequency in credential client mode; zero scans for it. Downstream 1.58.1 extension. 
peer
 
string
 

The P2P device that should be connected to. This is required for peer connections and must be unset when autonomous is TRUE.





psk


string



WPA passphrase or hexadecimal PSK for the existing group. Client only.





psk-flags


NMSettingSecretFlags (uint32)


0

Secret handling flags for the group PSK.





ssid


byte array



Raw SSID of the existing group, required in credential client mode.





wfd-ies


byte array



The Wi-Fi Display (WFD) Information Elements (IEs) to set.

Wi-Fi Display requires a protocol specific information element to be set in certain Wi-Fi frames. These can be specified here for the purpose of establishing a connection. This setting is only useful when implementing a Wi-Fi Display client.





wps-method


uint32


0

Flags indicating which mode of WPS is to be used.

There's little point in changing the default setting as NetworkManager will automatically determine the best method to use.
